label: Lifetime ISA
field.name: Name
field.subscribedThisYear: Lifetime ISA deposits already made this tax year
field.otherIsaAnnual: Annual deposits allocated to other ISAs
option.none: Keep the savings in the ISA
help.birthDay: Leave blank to use the last day of your birth month.
help.firstPaymentDate: Use the original eligible first payment. For a new account enter the first planned deposit date.
help.openingBalance: Use the balance at plan start, including bonuses already credited.
help.monthlyDeposit: Use only while eligible. The annual Lifetime ISA limit is £4,000, within the overall £20,000 ISA limit. The government bonus is 25% of eligible deposits.
help.subscribedThisYear: Enter deposits since 6 April before the plan began. ISA gains, bonuses and withdrawals have no effect on this amount.
help.otherIsaAnnual: Include current-year and planned subscriptions to other ISAs. If another ISA is modeled, allocate the same shared £20,000 limit there too.
help.contributionUntil: Leave blank to save while eligible until age 50 or account closure.
help.annualReturn: Enter nominal interest or investment growth after charges.
help.withdrawalReason: Ordinary withdrawals before age 60 have a 25% charge. The health exemption requires a confirmed eligible terminal prognosis.
help.withdrawalGross: Use zero to withdraw the entire balance and close the ISA.
help.homePrice: Confirm all first-home requirements, including the mortgage and conveyancer. Withdrawals above the £450,000 limit have a 20% charge from 29 October 2026.
invalid.owner: Select an individual with a valid month and day of birth.
invalid.duplicate: Use one modeled Lifetime ISA per person.
invalid.firstPayment: Enter the first payment date, when the account holder was between 18 and 39.
invalid.subscription: Check the opening pot, this tax year's Lifetime ISA deposits and the other ISA deposits.
invalid.contribution: Check the planned monthly contribution and its end date.
invalid.withdrawal: Choose a withdrawal reason and a valid date within the plan.
invalid.seasoning: A first-home withdrawal requires at least 12 months since the first Lifetime ISA payment.
